Tooltip_MDB_UpgradeBagTier1: The bag must be at tier 0 and not worn. Items inside can stay. The server sets the highest tier.
Tooltip_MDB_UpgradeBagTier2: The bag must be at tier 1 and not worn. Items inside can stay. The server sets the highest tier.
Tooltip_MDB_UpgradeBagTier3: The bag must be at tier 2 and not worn. Items inside can stay. The server sets the highest tier.
Tooltip_MDB_LegacyBag: Old Plus bag: items can be taken out but not put in. With a needle and thread, convert it into the reinforced version of the same bag at the highest tier; items inside can stay.
